engineering_objective: Complete a crash-safe embedded transactional store so concurrency, MVCC visibility, WAL recovery, checkpointing, corruption handling, operator state and restart behavior agree.

root_cause_clusters.RC_LOCK: Writer lock file exists but the starter does not hold the documented non-blocking exclusive process lock.
root_cause_clusters.RC_MVCC: Point reads and scans resolve committed versions against the latest sequence instead of the transaction snapshot.
root_cause_clusters.RC_SCAN: Scan composition and command-boundary handling do not preserve snapshot visibility, byte ordering, prefix filtering, local overlays and inclusive limits together.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CONFLICT: Commit lacks first-committer-wins stale-write arbitration before publication.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RECOVERY: WAL recovery conflates incomplete tails with complete corruption and can publish mutation records without a matching durable commit.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CHECKPOINT: Checkpoint lifecycle does not consistently enforce quiescence, preserve sequence/state and reclaim the WAL.
root_cause_clusters.RC_INTEGRITY: Snapshot/recovery validation and operator health accept or report inconsistent structural state.

defects.observable_failure: second writer opens concurrently
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating a LOCK file without a kernel-held exclusive lock still allows independent writer processes.

defects.observable_failure: LOCK is not actually held exclusively
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting a second process in higher-level code does not prove the documented advisory lock is held for the engine lifetime.

defects.observable_failure: writer handoff lacks kernel fencing
defects.partial_fix_trap: Acquiring a lock but leaking the descriptor or release lifecycle prevents clean writer handoff after exit.

defects.observable_failure: reader observes replacement committed after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing scans alone leaves point reads bound to the latest commit sequence.

defects.observable_failure: reader loses key deleted after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Handling newer puts but not tombstone visibility still violates snapshot semantics.

defects.observable_failure: scan acquires insert committed after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Applying a local overlay on top of a latest-state scan still leaks post-BEGIN commits.

defects.observable_failure: scan loses row deleted after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Filtering current tombstones before selecting the transaction snapshot drops rows that should remain visible.

defects.observable_failure: local insert is absent from prefix scan
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reading the correct snapshot without overlaying transaction-local writes breaks read-your-writes.

defects.observable_failure: local delete does not suppress snapshot row
defects.partial_fix_trap: Overlaying only local puts leaves locally deleted snapshot rows visible.

defects.observable_failure: high-bit keys use incorrect ordering
defects.partial_fix_trap: Text or signed-character ordering can look correct for ASCII fixtures while misordering binary keys.

defects.observable_failure: scan prefix boundary handling diverges from key contract
defects.partial_fix_trap: Repairing PUT/GET key limits without applying the same inclusive boundary to SCAN leaves the protocol inconsistent.

defects.observable_failure: stale put commits over newer version
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking conflicts after WAL publication is too late to preserve atomicity and sequence semantics.

defects.observable_failure: stale delete commits over newer version
defects.partial_fix_trap: Conflict logic that only considers value writes misses deletes touching a newer committed version.

defects.observable_failure: multi-key stale transaction is not atomically rejected
defects.partial_fix_trap: Per-key publication before complete conflict arbitration can expose a subset of an otherwise rejected transaction.

defects.observable_failure: rejected conflict can disturb commit sequencing
defects.partial_fix_trap: Allocating the next durable sequence before conflict rejection creates gaps even when no writes publish.

defects.observable_failure: killed transaction mutation becomes visible after restart
defects.partial_fix_trap: Replaying mutation records eagerly instead of buffering by transaction makes an uncommitted crash visible.

defects.observable_failure: rolled-back mutation becomes visible after restart
defects.partial_fix_trap: Synthesizing commits from pending mutation groups after replay converts rollback/no-COMMIT history into durable state.

defects.observable_failure: short final WAL header is mishandled
defects.partial_fix_trap: Treating every short read as corruption rejects legitimate torn-tail crash recovery.

defects.observable_failure: short final WAL payload is mishandled
defects.partial_fix_trap: Handling short headers but not short payloads leaves a second torn-tail boundary incorrect.

defects.observable_failure: complete checksum damage is mistaken for torn tail
defects.partial_fix_trap: Truncating a complete bad-checksum record silently destroys evidence instead of failing closed.

defects.observable_failure: complete bad magic is silently discarded
defects.partial_fix_trap: Using the torn-tail repair path for a complete invalid header accepts structural corruption.

defects.observable_failure: non-contiguous commit sequence is accepted
defects.partial_fix_trap: Valid CRC and record shape do not make a commit sequence valid when durable history skips a sequence.

defects.observable_failure: checkpoint runs with active transaction
defects.partial_fix_trap: Publishing a snapshot while transactions remain live can capture state inconsistent with the transaction lifecycle.

defects.observable_failure: successful checkpoint leaves WAL bytes behind
defects.partial_fix_trap: Syncing WAL without truncating and rewinding it does not reclaim the log promised by checkpoint.

defects.observable_failure: checkpoint restart loses sequence or rows
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing rows while resetting or failing to persist the checkpoint sequence produces a snapshot that cannot resume contiguous history.

defects.observable_failure: snapshot row checksum corruption is accepted
defects.partial_fix_trap: Parsing the stored CRC without comparing it leaves otherwise well-formed corrupted rows trusted.

defects.observable_failure: snapshot trailing bytes are accepted
defects.partial_fix_trap: Validating declared rows without requiring end-of-file equality permits an alternate ambiguous disk image.

defects.observable_failure: abandoned snapshot temporary is not cleaned
defects.partial_fix_trap: Ignoring stale snapshot.tmp may leave interrupted maintenance state visible to later operations even when snapshot.dat is valid.

defects.observable_failure: HEALTH active transaction count is stale
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reporting durable catalog state alone cannot describe live transaction reachability.

defects.observable_failure: HEALTH snapshot state diverges from checkpoint state
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hard-coded snapshot status can disagree with the filesystem immediately after checkpoint or restart.
